name: Nadia Alexandra Petrakis Vandermeer
extra_bullets: Wrote and submitted a second-round grant proposal for seedling planting trials with the regional forest restoration partnership
Taught two field safety workshops for new graduate students and kept the department's first aid kits and radios up to date
cover_letter_paragraph: Outside my own projects, I've helped run the department's graduate writing group for three years. We meet weekly, set small goals and read each other's drafts. It has made me a better writer and a more patient reader, and I'd like to start something similar for graduate students at Pinemoor.

extra_reference.name: Daniel Okonjo
extra_reference.relationship: Co-author on two papers and field collaborator
